description: The image presents two side-by-side pie charts, titled "All Changes" and "All Errors," which represent the proportion of correct corrections among various error detection results. Both charts are divided into six slices corresponding to categories identified in a shared legend on the right: P (light green), PW (light green with a bold dark green border), R (pale yellow), RW (pale yellow with a bold dark yellow border), N (light blue), and NW (light blue with a bold dark blue border). Percentage labels and their corresponding category colors are displayed outside the pie charts, with the percentages connected to their respective slices by thin guide lines. Visually, all slices in both charts are exploded, meaning they are slightly offset from the center. Additionally, the slices representing the "W" categories (PW, RW, NW) are visually emphasized with thick, dark borders. The segments are arranged clockwise and appear ordered by their base color groups (green, then yellow, then blue) rather than by strictly descending or ascending size. In the "All Changes" chart, the proportions are 50% for P, 4% for PW, 26% for R, 14% for RW, 1% for N, and 5% for NW. In the "All Errors" chart, the distribution is 56% for P, 3% for PW, 29% for R, 6% for RW, 1% for N, and 5% for NW.
